detail.title: USB Type C Cable 0.1 m Charging Cable
detail.overview: The Bestor USB Type-C Cable with Fidget Spinner is a 4-in-1 charging solution combining utility and fun. Featuring dual input ports (USB-A and USB-C), it ensures compatibility with most devices. Its compact 0.1-meter length offers tangle-free charging, while the built-in fidget spinner provides stress relief on the go. Durable, lightweight, and portable, this innovative cable is perfect for both work and travel.
